# Kova

> The self-improving AI agent — your bots, your cloud, your rules.

Kova creates skills from experience, remembers who you are, runs scheduled
routines, and drives a real terminal and browser. One agent core, every
surface: CLI, desktop app, Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, and more.

## Key Features

- **Skills**: Learns your workflows — reusable procedures it improves over time
- **Bots**: Spawn specialist bots with their own persona, memory, and model
- **Routines**: Scheduled jobs that run even when your machine is off
- **Terminal + Browser**: Drives a real terminal and browser
- **Memory**: Remembers who you are across sessions
- **Any model**: OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, local + 20 more

## Pricing

- Free forever, fully open source (MIT)

## Platforms

- Windows
- macOS
- Linux
- Messaging: Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal, and more
